Desktop OS.reason_en: Missing authentication in WatchGuard's kernel driver allows local attackers to bypass security handshakes and extract encryption keys, severely compromising endpoint protection.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: WatchGuard 内核驱动中缺失认证机制，允许本地攻击者绕过安全握手并提取加密密钥，严重削弱终端防护能力。

Desktop OS.reason: Incomplete validation in OpenClaw's approval system accepts wildcard rules and abused system binaries, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Incomplete validation in OpenClaw's approval system accepts wildcard rules and abused system binaries, enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: OpenClaw 审批系统中存在验证不完整问题，会接受通配符规则及被滥用的系统二进制文件，使远程攻击者能够在受管 Windows 节点上执行任意命令。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap buffer overflow during libsolv package manager decompression allows crafted repository files to crash systems or potentially achieve code execution on Linux distributions.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow during libsolv package manager decompression allows crafted repository files to crash systems or potentially achieve code execution on Linux distributions.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: libsolv 包管理器解压过程中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，精心构造的仓库文件可能导致系统崩溃或在 Linux 发行版上实现代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: Physical attackers can inject unsigned Linux loader parameters into the bootloader configuration, bypassing secure boot mechanisms and enabling unauthorized kernel modifications or persistence.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Physical attackers can inject unsigned Linux loader parameters into the bootloader configuration, bypassing secure boot mechanisms and enabling unauthorized kernel modifications or persistence.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 物理攻击者可将未签名的 Linux 加载器参数注入引导程序配置中，绕过安全启动机制，从而实现未经授权的内核修改或持久化驻留。

Desktop OS.reason: Ghostscript heap-based buffer overflow in JPEG 2000 processing allows arbitrary code execution via crafted PDFs, heavily impacting desktop document viewers.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Ghostscript heap-based buffer overflow in JPEG 2000 processing allows arbitrary code execution via crafted PDFs, heavily impacting desktop document viewers.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Ghostscript在处理JPEG 2000时存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的PDF文件实现任意代码执行，严重影响桌面文档查看器。

Desktop OS.reason: Acunetix local privilege escalation grants SYSTEM-level access by exploiting hardcoded OpenSSL directory paths, compromising desktop vulnerability scanning workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Acunetix local privilege escalation grants SYSTEM-level access by exploiting hardcoded OpenSSL directory paths, compromising desktop vulnerability scanning workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Acunetix存在本地权限提升漏洞，通过利用硬编码的OpenSSL目录路径可获得SYSTEM级权限，危及桌面漏洞扫描工作站。

Desktop OS.reason: NetBSD use-after-free and double-free in the 32-bit compatibility layer enables local kernel memory corruption and potential privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: NetBSD use-after-free and double-free in the 32-bit compatibility layer enables local kernel memory corruption and potential privilege escalation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: NetBSD在32位兼容层中存在释放后使用和双重释放漏洞，可导致本地内核内存损坏及潜在的权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap buffer overflow in GIMP's PSP file loader allows remote code execution when processing crafted compressed images, directly impacting desktop application security.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in GIMP's PSP file loader allows remote code execution when processing crafted compressed images, directly impacting desktop application security.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GIMP的PSP文件加载器存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，在处理构造的压缩图像时可导致远程代码执行，直接影响桌面应用程序安全。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free race condition in the Linux kernel's Bluetooth SDIO driver can lead to local privilege escalation or kernel panics on affected desktop and embedded systems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free race condition in the Linux kernel's Bluetooth SDIO driver can lead to local privilege escalation or kernel panics on affected desktop and embedded systems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Linux内核蓝牙SDIO驱动中存在释放后使用竞态条件，可能导致受影响的桌面和嵌入式系统发生本地权限提升或内核崩溃。

Desktop OS.reason: Kernel-mode ioctl input validation failure allows unprivileged users to perform out-of-bounds writes, enabling local privilege escalation on workstation systems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Kernel-mode ioctl input validation failure allows unprivileged users to perform out-of-bounds writes, enabling local privilege escalation on workstation systems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 内核模式下的ioctl输入验证失败允许非特权用户执行越界写入，从而在工作站系统上实现本地权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Handle recycle race conditions cause type confusion in the GPU driver, granting attackers cross-process memory access and potential code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Handle recycle race conditions cause type confusion in the GPU driver, granting attackers cross-process memory access and potential code execution.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GPU驱动中的句柄回收竞态条件会导致类型混淆，使攻击者能够进行跨进程内存访问并可能执行代码。

Desktop OS.reason: Structural search script constraints in IDE projects can be abused to execute arbitrary code, posing a significant risk to developer workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Structural search script constraints in IDE projects can be abused to execute arbitrary code, posing a significant risk to developer workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: IDE项目中的结构搜索脚本约束可被滥用以执行任意代码，对开发者工作站构成重大风险。

Mobile Security.reason: CVSS 8.6 improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator allows local privilege escalation, undermining mobile identity verification.
Mobile Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.6 improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator allows local privilege escalation, undermining mobile identity verification.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator存在CVSS评分为8.6的身份验证缺陷，可导致本地权限提升，削弱移动身份验证机制。

Mobile Security.reason: WebView JavaScript injection on shared networks enables attackers to access clipboards, make arbitrary HTTP requests, and abuse app-internal storage without permissions.
Mobile Security.reason_en: WebView JavaScript injection on shared networks enables attackers to access clipboards, make arbitrary HTTP requests, and abuse app-internal storage without permissions.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 在共享网络上，WebView JavaScript注入可使攻击者在无需权限的情况下访问剪贴板、发起任意HTTP请求并滥用应用内部存储。

Mobile Security.reason: Capacitor runtime fails to validate URL paths in WebViews, allowing malicious links to navigate to privileged internal app pages and expose sensitive mobile data.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Capacitor runtime fails to validate URL paths in WebViews, allowing malicious links to navigate to privileged internal app pages and expose sensitive mobile data.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Capacitor运行时未对WebView中的URL路径进行验证，导致恶意链接可跳转至特权内部应用页面，从而泄露敏感移动数据。

Mobile Security.reason: A buffer overflow in clipboard redirection during peer synchronization allows remote code execution on mobile endpoints, compromising session data and device integrity.
Mobile Security.reason_en: A buffer overflow in clipboard redirection during peer synchronization allows remote code execution on mobile endpoints, compromising session data and device integrity.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 对等同步期间的剪贴板重定向存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在移动终端上实现远程代码执行，破坏会话数据与设备完整性。

Mobile Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Fleet's device API accepts non-secret identifiers as tokens, allowing unauthenticated attackers to impersonate managed iOS/iPadOS devices and bypass MDM controls.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Fleet's device API accepts non-secret identifiers as tokens, allowing unauthenticated attackers to impersonate managed iOS/iPadOS devices and bypass MDM controls.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Fleet的设备API存在认证绕过漏洞，会将非密钥标识符当作令牌接受，使未认证的攻击者能够冒充受管iOS/iPadOS设备并绕过MDM控制。

IoT Security.reason: The dracut initramfs generator writes unquoted error messages into shell scripts, enabling command injection via DHCP options. This poses a critical risk to embedded systems and edge devices relying on network boot.
IoT Security.reason_en: The dracut initramfs generator writes unquoted error messages into shell scripts, enabling command injection via DHCP options. This poses a critical risk to embedded systems and edge devices relying on network boot.
IoT Security.reason_zh: dracut initramfs生成器会将未加引号的错误消息写入Shell脚本，从而可通过DHCP选项实现命令注入。这对依赖网络启动的嵌入式系统和边缘设备构成严重风险。

IoT Security.reason: Improper handling of crafted DHCP options in dracut's legacy path allows adjacent network attackers to inject commands. Widely affects IoT firmware provisioning and automated deployment pipelines.
IoT Security.reason_en: Improper handling of crafted DHCP options in dracut's legacy path allows adjacent network attackers to inject commands. Widely affects IoT firmware provisioning and automated deployment pipelines.
IoT Security.reason_zh: dracut旧版路径中对构造的DHCP选项处理不当，允许相邻网络攻击者注入命令。广泛影响IoT固件配置与自动化部署流水线。

IoT Security.reason: Critical path traversal in Teledyne FLIR robot firmware exposes sensitive configuration and security parameters to unauthenticated remote attackers.
IoT Security.reason_en: Critical path traversal in Teledyne FLIR robot firmware exposes sensitive configuration and security parameters to unauthenticated remote attackers.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Teledyne FLIR机器人固件中存在严重路径遍历漏洞，可向未认证的远程攻击者暴露敏感配置与安全参数。

IoT Security.reason: Hardcoded credentials in Teledyne FLIR Aware2 allow unauthorized actors to fully reconfigure robotic systems without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in Teledyne FLIR Aware2 allow unauthorized actors to fully reconfigure robotic systems without authentication.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Teledyne FLIR Aware2中存在硬编码凭据，未授权实体可在无需认证的情况下完全重新配置机器人系统。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated RCE in Thales SConnect exploits cryptographic and memory management flaws to compromise host machines running the native host component.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in Thales SConnect exploits cryptographic and memory management flaws to compromise host machines running the native host component.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Thales SConnect存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，通过利用加密与内存管理缺陷可攻破运行原生主机组件的主机。

IoT Security.reason: Cleartext transmission in control endpoints allows remote attackers to intercept and hijack session traffic for critical robotic systems via network sniffing.
IoT Security.reason_en: Cleartext transmission in control endpoints allows remote attackers to intercept and hijack session traffic for critical robotic systems via network sniffing.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 控制端点的明文传输使远程攻击者能够通过网络嗅探拦截并劫持关键机器人系统的会话流量。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the firmware web interface grants attackers full root-level control over the network extender.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the firmware web interface grants attackers full root-level control over the network extender.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 固件Web界面存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，使攻击者能够完全掌控网络扩展器的root级权限。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated OS command injection via the password parameter enables immediate remote takeover of audio streaming appliances.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection via the password parameter enables immediate remote takeover of audio streaming appliances.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 通过密码参数存在未认证操作系统命令注入漏洞，可导致音频流媒体设备被立即远程接管。

IoT Security.reason: Allows arbitrary file writes with system privileges on Samsung MagicINFO servers, enabling full device compromise and potential ransomware deployment on digital signage networks.
IoT Security.reason_en: Allows arbitrary file writes with system privileges on Samsung MagicINFO servers, enabling full device compromise and potential ransomware deployment on digital signage networks.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 允许在Samsung MagicINFO服务器上以系统权限执行任意文件写入，从而实现设备完全控制并在数字标牌网络中部署勒索软件。

IoT Security.reason: Local network attackers can replay authentication challenges to hijack administrative sessions on Tapo cameras, granting full control over surveillance feeds and device settings.
IoT Security.reason_en: Local network attackers can replay authentication challenges to hijack administrative sessions on Tapo cameras, granting full control over surveillance feeds and device settings.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 局域网攻击者可重放身份验证挑战以劫持Tapo摄像头的管理会话，从而完全控制监控视频流及设备设置。

IoT Security.reason: Lack of server-side authorization on password changes allows authenticated users to overwrite installer/admin passwords, seizing control of multi-user smart building gateways.
IoT Security.reason_en: Lack of server-side authorization on password changes allows authenticated users to overwrite installer/admin passwords, seizing control of multi-user smart building gateways.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 密码修改功能缺乏服务端授权验证，允许已认证用户覆盖安装程序或管理员密码，从而夺取多用户智能建筑网关的控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated on-path attackers can crash the BGP routing service by sending malformed NLRI messages, disrupting network segmentation and causing denial of service in IoT gateway deployments.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated on-path attackers can crash the BGP routing service by sending malformed NLRI messages, disrupting network segmentation and causing denial of service in IoT gateway deployments.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 未认证的中间人攻击者可通过发送格式错误的NLRI消息导致BGP路由服务崩溃，破坏网络分段并在IoT网关部署中引发拒绝服务。

IoT Security.reason: Voltronic Power SNMP Web Pro allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious firmware uploads, directly compromising critical power inversion hardware.
IoT Security.reason_en: Voltronic Power SNMP Web Pro allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious firmware uploads, directly compromising critical power inversion hardware.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Voltronic Power SNMP Web Pro允许通过恶意固件上传实现未认证远程代码执行，直接危及关键电力逆变硬件。

IoT Security.reason: Ziroom ZHOME smart home device suffers remote command injection via WiFi setup APIs, enabling attackers to fully compromise residential IoT ecosystems.
IoT Security.reason_en: Ziroom ZHOME smart home device suffers remote command injection via WiFi setup APIs, enabling attackers to fully compromise residential IoT ecosystems.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Ziroom ZHOME智能家居设备通过WiFi设置API存在远程命令注入漏洞，使攻击者能够完全控制住宅IoT生态系统。

IoT Security.reason: Eibiz Digital Signage authentication bypass via AMF object manipulation allows unauthenticated creation of admin accounts, seizing control of public display networks.
IoT Security.reason_en: Eibiz Digital Signage authentication bypass via AMF object manipulation allows unauthenticated creation of admin accounts, seizing control of public display networks.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Eibiz Digital Signage通过操纵AMF对象实现认证绕过，允许未认证创建管理员账户，从而夺取公共显示网络控制权。

IoT Security.reason: Unauthenticated local file inclusion in Sharp and Toshiba multifunction printers enables remote attackers to read sensitive system files via directory traversal in the manual download endpoint.
IoT Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated local file inclusion in Sharp and Toshiba multifunction printers enables remote attackers to read sensitive system files via directory traversal in the manual download endpoint.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Sharp和Toshiba多功能打印机存在未认证本地文件包含漏洞，远程攻击者可通过手动下载端点的目录遍历读取敏感系统文件。

IoT Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in the router's search endpoint allows attackers to bypass URL validation and probe internal networks, exposing restricted IoT and backend services.
IoT Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in the router's search endpoint allows attackers to bypass URL validation and probe internal networks, exposing restricted IoT and backend services.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 路由器搜索端点存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，使攻击者能够绕过URL验证并探测内部网络，暴露受限的IoT与后端服务。

Cloud Security.reason: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. This threatens tenant isolation and data governance in enterprise analytics platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. This threatens tenant isolation and data governance in enterprise analytics platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric 中利用欺骗的认证绕过漏洞可导致网络未授权权限提升，危及企业分析平台的租户隔离与数据治理。

Cloud Security.reason: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL enables privilege escalation over the network. Compromises managed database integrity and exposes sensitive cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL enables privilege escalation over the network. Compromises managed database integrity and exposes sensitive cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 中的授权不当漏洞可导致网络权限提升，破坏托管数据库完整性并暴露敏感云工作负载。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication for critical functions in Azure AI Language allows unauthenticated privilege escalation. Exposes core AI service endpoints to abuse and potential data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical functions in Azure AI Language allows unauthenticated privilege escalation. Exposes core AI service endpoints to abuse and potential data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 关键功能缺失认证机制可导致未授权权限提升，使核心 AI 服务接口面临滥用及潜在数据外泄风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Flawed authentication mechanisms in Azure-integrated cloud services allow unauthorized privilege elevation, jeopardizing cloud workload security and multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Flawed authentication mechanisms in Azure-integrated cloud services allow unauthorized privilege elevation, jeopardizing cloud workload security and multi-tenant isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 集成 Azure 的云服务中存在的认证机制缺陷可导致未授权权限提升，危及云工作负载安全与多租户隔离。

Cloud Security.reason: Unsafe deserialization in the Dynamics 365 platform enables remote code execution, posing severe risks to enterprise SaaS deployments and business logic integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in the Dynamics 365 platform enables remote code execution, posing severe risks to enterprise SaaS deployments and business logic integrity.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 平台的不安全反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对企业 SaaS 部署及业务逻辑完整性构成严重威胁。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 7.2 command injection in Azure HDInsights allows network privilege escalation, endangering cloud data processing workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.2 command injection in Azure HDInsights allows network privilege escalation, endangering cloud data processing workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure HDInsights 中存在 CVSS 评分为 7.2 的命令注入漏洞，可导致网络权限提升，危及云数据处理工作负载。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 code injection in Dynamics 365 enables remote code execution, compromising enterprise SaaS environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 code injection in Dynamics 365 enables remote code execution, compromising enterprise SaaS environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的代码注入漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，危及企业 SaaS 环境。

Cloud Security.reason: CVSS 7.4 command injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 command injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat 中存在 CVSS 评分为 7.4 的命令注入漏洞，可导致网络未授权信息泄露。

Cloud Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V permits local code execution, potentially enabling hypervisor escapes that compromise multi-tenant cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V permits local code execution, potentially enabling hypervisor escapes that compromise multi-tenant cloud workloads.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地代码执行，进而可能引发虚拟机管理程序逃逸，危及多租户云工作负载。

Cloud Security.reason: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation Service discloses sensitive information over the network, undermining device health verification and conditional access policies.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation Service discloses sensitive information over the network, undermining device health verification and conditional access policies.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Attestation Service 中的越界读取漏洞可导致敏感信息通过网络泄露，破坏设备健康验证与条件访问策略。

Cloud Security.reason: Double-free vulnerability in Windows Credential Guard allows local privilege escalation, weakening hardware-backed security isolation essential for modern cloud identity protection.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Double-free vulnerability in Windows Credential Guard allows local privilege escalation, weakening hardware-backed security isolation essential for modern cloud identity protection.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard 中的双重释放漏洞可导致本地权限提升，削弱现代云身份保护所依赖的硬件级安全隔离机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication in Azure AI Foundry enables unauthenticated privilege escalation, posing severe risks to cloud AI workload isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Foundry enables unauthenticated privilege escalation, posing severe risks to cloud AI workload isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 缺失认证机制可导致未授权权限提升，对云 AI 工作负载隔离构成严重威胁。

Cloud Security.reason: Path traversal vulnerability in Azure Logic Apps allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges across cloud automation pipelines.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Azure Logic Apps allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges across cloud automation pipelines.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Logic Apps 中的路径遍历漏洞可使未授权攻击者在云自动化流水线中提升权限。

Cloud Security.reason: Authentication bypass via alternate channel in Microsoft Entra ID compromises foundational identity management infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via alternate channel in Microsoft Entra ID compromises foundational identity management infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中通过备用通道实现的认证绕过漏洞破坏了基础身份管理架构。

Cloud Security.reason: Path traversal in the Supabase node allows attackers to traverse filesystem boundaries and access unauthorized database tables within automated workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Path traversal in the Supabase node allows attackers to traverse filesystem boundaries and access unauthorized database tables within automated workflows.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Supabase 节点中的路径遍历漏洞可使攻击者突破文件系统边界，在自动化工作流中访问未授权的数据库表。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated OS command injection in the billing module bypasses authentication controls to execute arbitrary commands as root on hosting platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection in the billing module bypasses authentication controls to execute arbitrary commands as root on hosting platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 计费模块中的未授权操作系统命令注入漏洞可绕过认证控制，在托管平台上以 root 权限执行任意命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Arbitrary file read via unvalidated API parameters exposes sensitive human capital management data hosted on the cloud infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Arbitrary file read via unvalidated API parameters exposes sensitive human capital management data hosted on the cloud infrastructure.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 通过未经验证的 API 参数实现的任意文件读取漏洞，会暴露托管于云基础设施上的敏感人力资源管理数据。

Cloud Security.reason: Critical RCE in the Ray AI framework exploitable via standard browsers allows attackers to compromise distributed computing clusters and steal sensitive ML training data.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Critical RCE in the Ray AI framework exploitable via standard browsers allows attackers to compromise distributed computing clusters and steal sensitive ML training data.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Ray AI 框架中存在可通过标准浏览器利用的关键远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可借此入侵分布式计算集群并窃取敏感机器学习训练数据。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated SSRF in MLflow's webhook testing endpoint allows attackers to probe internal cloud metadata services and exfiltrate instance credentials from AI/ML platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SSRF in MLflow's webhook testing endpoint allows attackers to probe internal cloud metadata services and exfiltrate instance credentials from AI/ML platforms.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: MLflow 的 Webhook 测试端点存在未授权服务器端请求伪造漏洞，攻击者可借此探测内部云元数据服务，并从 AI/ML 平台外泄实例凭证。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated SSRF via devfile endpoints forces the OpenShift console pod to communicate with internal services, facilitating lateral movement and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated SSRF via devfile endpoints forces the OpenShift console pod to communicate with internal services, facilitating lateral movement and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 通过 Devfile 端点触发的未授权 SSRF 漏洞会强制 OpenShift Console Pod 与内部服务通信，助长攻击者横向移动与数据外泄。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated actors can register arbitrary worker addresses under victim model names, enabling server-side request forgery and interception of user prompts in cloud-hosted AI inference pipelines.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated actors can register arbitrary worker addresses under victim model names, enabling server-side request forgery and interception of user prompts in cloud-hosted AI inference pipelines.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 未授权攻击者可在受害模型名下注册任意 Worker 地址，从而触发服务器端请求伪造，并拦截托管于云端的 AI 推理流水线中的用户提示词。

Cloud Security.reason: Proxmox VE authentication bypass circumvents two-factor enforcement, allowing unauthenticated actors to impersonate any enabled user and seize virtual environment control.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Proxmox VE authentication bypass circumvents two-factor enforcement, allowing unauthenticated actors to impersonate any enabled user and seize virtual environment control.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Proxmox VE 的认证绕过漏洞可规避双因素认证强制要求，使未授权攻击者能够冒充任意已启用用户并接管虚拟环境控制权。

Cloud Security.reason: Volcengine OpenViking SSRF enables low-privilege authenticated users to probe internal cloud services and exfiltrate sensitive infrastructure metadata.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Volcengine OpenViking SSRF enables low-privilege authenticated users to probe internal cloud services and exfiltrate sensitive infrastructure metadata.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Volcengine OpenViking 的 SSRF 漏洞使低权限已认证用户能够探测内部云服务，并外泄敏感的基础设施元数据。

Cloud Security.reason: Apache APISIX batch-requests plugin causes gateway worker out-of-memory crashes under unauthenticated load, severely disrupting cloud API gateway availability.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Apache APISIX batch-requests plugin causes gateway worker out-of-memory crashes under unauthenticated load, severely disrupting cloud API gateway availability.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Apache APISIX 的 batch-requests 插件在未授权流量压力下会导致网关 Worker 进程内存耗尽崩溃，严重破坏云 API 网关的可用性。

Cloud Security.reason: Flawed password reset validation allows unauthenticated attackers to reset user passwords using only known email addresses, bypassing secure recovery mechanisms in Kiteworks deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Flawed password reset validation allows unauthenticated attackers to reset user passwords using only known email addresses, bypassing secure recovery mechanisms in Kiteworks deployments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 密码重置验证机制存在缺陷，使未授权攻击者仅需已知邮箱即可重置用户密码，从而绕过 Kiteworks 部署中的安全找回机制。

Cloud Security.reason: Weak certificate binding enables attackers to associate encryption certificates with other users' accounts, compromising the confidentiality and integrity of encrypted cloud communications.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Weak certificate binding enables attackers to associate encryption certificates with other users' accounts, compromising the confidentiality and integrity of encrypted cloud communications.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 证书绑定强度不足漏洞使攻击者能够将加密证书关联至其他用户账户，破坏加密云通信的机密性与完整性。

Cloud Security.reason: Stored XSS in Kiteworks Core allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious JavaScript into admin sessions, facilitating full account takeover and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Kiteworks Core allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious JavaScript into admin sessions, facilitating full account takeover and data exfiltration.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Kiteworks Core 中存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，未授权攻击者可向管理员会话注入恶意 JavaScript，从而实现完全账户接管与数据外泄。

Cloud Security.reason: Inconsistent enforcement of administrative authentication in the Email Protection Gateway allows password bypass, granting unauthorized access to critical cloud security management functions.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Inconsistent enforcement of administrative authentication in the Email Protection Gateway allows password bypass, granting unauthorized access to critical cloud security management functions.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Email Protection Gateway 的管理员认证执行不一致漏洞可导致密码绕过，使未授权用户能够访问关键的云安全管理功能。

Cloud Security.reason: Persistent SSRF vulnerability in the email gateway enables unauthenticated attackers to force internal network requests, exposing restricted cloud resources and backend services.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Persistent SSRF vulnerability in the email gateway enables unauthenticated attackers to force internal network requests, exposing restricted cloud resources and backend services.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 邮件网关中存在持久的 SSRF 漏洞，可使未授权攻击者强制发起内部网络请求，从而暴露受限云资源与后端服务。

Cloud Security.reason: Checkpoint restore bypass in CRI-O allows malicious containers to retain dangerous Linux capabilities and seccomp states, undermining Kubernetes security contexts in cloud-native environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Checkpoint restore bypass in CRI-O allows malicious containers to retain dangerous Linux capabilities and seccomp states, undermining Kubernetes security contexts in cloud-native environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: CRI-O 的检查点恢复绕过漏洞可使恶意容器保留高危 Linux 能力与 seccomp 状态，破坏云原生环境中的 Kubernetes 安全上下文。

Cloud Security.reason: Unauthenticated registry binding in oc-mirror exposes container image mirroring operations to adjacent network attackers, risking image tampering and supply chain compromise.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated registry binding in oc-mirror exposes container image mirroring operations to adjacent network attackers, risking image tampering and supply chain compromise.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: oc-mirror 中的未认证注册表绑定漏洞使容器镜像同步操作暴露于相邻网络攻击者面前，存在镜像篡改与供应链遭破坏的风险。

Cloud Security.reason: Integer overflow in the vGPU manager kernel module allows guest VMs to corrupt host memory, creating a viable virtual machine escape vector.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in the vGPU manager kernel module allows guest VMs to corrupt host memory, creating a viable virtual machine escape vector.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: vGPU 管理器内核模块中的整数溢出漏洞允许客户机虚拟机破坏主机内存，从而构成可行的虚拟机逃逸向量。

Cloud Security.reason: Flawed authorization checks permit guest users to access privileged host GPU resources, directly compromising multi-tenant cloud isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Flawed authorization checks permit guest users to access privileged host GPU resources, directly compromising multi-tenant cloud isolation.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: 存在缺陷的授权检查机制允许访客用户访问特权主机 GPU 资源，直接破坏了多租户云环境的隔离性。

Cloud Security.reason: Crafted RPC messages in the GSP plugin trigger out-of-bounds writes, potentially allowing VM-to-host privilege escalation in virtualized environments.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Crafted RPC messages in the GSP plugin trigger out-of-bounds writes, potentially allowing VM-to-host privilege escalation in virtualized environments.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: GSP 插件中精心构造的 RPC 消息会触发越界写入，在虚拟化环境中可能导致虚拟机向主机提权。

Cloud Security.reason: Invalid performance state parameters in vGPU RPC calls cause out-of-bounds writes, threatening hypervisor stability and tenant security boundaries.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Invalid performance state parameters in vGPU RPC calls cause out-of-bounds writes, threatening hypervisor stability and tenant security boundaries.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: vGPU RPC 调用中传入无效的性能状态参数会导致越界写入，威胁 Hypervisor 的稳定性及租户的安全边界。

Network Devices.reason: Access control bypass in PCP's pmproxy allows metric overwrites that lead to arbitrary code execution. Affects network performance monitoring infrastructure deployed in data centers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Access control bypass in PCP's pmproxy allows metric overwrites that lead to arbitrary code execution. Affects network performance monitoring infrastructure deployed in data centers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: PCP 的 pmproxy 中存在访问控制绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞覆盖指标数据并导致任意代码执行。该漏洞影响数据中心内部署的网络性能监控基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Command injection in PCP's linux_sockets PMDA executes arbitrary commands via unsanitized network metrics. Enables lateral movement and persistence in monitored enterprise networks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Command injection in PCP's linux_sockets PMDA executes arbitrary commands via unsanitized network metrics. Enables lateral movement and persistence in monitored enterprise networks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: PCP 的 linux_sockets PMDA 中存在命令注入漏洞，可通过未经过滤的网络指标数据执行任意命令，从而支持在受管企业网络中进行横向移动与持久化驻留。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver (RMCAST) allows remote code execution over the network. Impacts multicast routing stacks on Windows server environments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver (RMCAST) allows remote code execution over the network. Impacts multicast routing stacks on Windows server environments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 可靠多播传输驱动程序（RMCAST）中存在释放后使用漏洞，可允许通过网络实现远程代码执行。该漏洞影响 Windows Server 环境中的多播路由协议栈。

Network Devices.reason: Enables direct remote code execution on critical routing infrastructure, allowing attackers to pivot across enterprise networks, intercept traffic, or destabilize connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_en: Enables direct remote code execution on critical routing infrastructure, allowing attackers to pivot across enterprise networks, intercept traffic, or destabilize connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者在关键路由基础设施上直接执行远程代码，进而使其能够跨企业网络进行横向跳转、拦截网络流量或破坏网络连通性。

Network Devices.reason: Compromises high-availability cluster management over the network, risking widespread service disruption and privilege escalation in virtualized and data center environments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Compromises high-availability cluster management over the network, risking widespread service disruption and privilege escalation in virtualized and data center environments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 该漏洞通过网络破坏了高可用集群的管理功能，在虚拟化与数据中心环境中可能导致大规模服务中断及权限提升风险。

Network Devices.reason: Allows remote code execution via the DNS server component, threatening core name resolution services and enabling lateral movement within internal networks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Allows remote code execution via the DNS server component, threatening core name resolution services and enabling lateral movement within internal networks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者通过 DNS 服务器组件实现远程代码执行，严重威胁核心域名解析服务，并为内部网络中的横向移动提供条件。

Network Devices.reason: Exploits the secure tunneling protocol used for VPN connections, granting unauthorized network access and potential full system compromise to remote users.
Network Devices.reason_en: Exploits the secure tunneling protocol used for VPN connections, granting unauthorized network access and potential full system compromise to remote users.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 该漏洞利用了 VPN 连接所使用的安全隧道协议，可为远程攻击者提供未授权的网络访问权限，并可能导致系统被完全接管。

Network Devices.reason: Heap overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution. Compromising DHCP infrastructure can disrupt network operations and facilitate lateral movement across entire subnets.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution. Compromising DHCP infrastructure can disrupt network operations and facilitate lateral movement across entire subnets.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在堆溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。DHCP 基础设施一旦被攻破，将中断网络正常运行，并助长攻击者在整个子网范围内的横向移动。

Network Devices.reason: Heap overflow in Windows RNDIS allows remote code execution over a network. As RNDIS handles USB-to-network bridging, this vulnerability exposes virtualized and mobile device connections to immediate takeover.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows RNDIS allows remote code execution over a network. As RNDIS handles USB-to-network bridging, this vulnerability exposes virtualized and mobile device connections to immediate takeover.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows RNDIS 中存在堆溢出漏洞，可允许通过网络实现远程代码执行。由于 RNDIS 负责 USB 至网络的桥接功能，该漏洞使得虚拟化设备及移动设备的网络连接面临被立即接管的风险。

Network Devices.reason: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS grants unauthorized machine access. Enterprise reliance on remote access services makes this a critical risk for perimeter security and VPN deployments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS grants unauthorized machine access. Enterprise reliance on remote access services makes this a critical risk for perimeter security and VPN deployments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 中存在远程代码执行漏洞，可导致未授权的设备访问。鉴于企业对远程访问服务的重度依赖，该漏洞对网络边界安全及 VPN 部署构成重大风险。

Network Devices.reason: Stack overflow in Windows DHCP Server permits remote code execution. Combined with other DHCP flaws, it highlights severe instability and exploitation risks in core network services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack overflow in Windows DHCP Server permits remote code execution. Combined with other DHCP flaws, it highlights severe instability and exploitation risks in core network services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在栈溢出漏洞，可允许远程代码执行。该漏洞若与其他 DHCP 缺陷结合利用，将凸显核心网络服务存在的严重不稳定性及被利用风险。

Network Devices.reason: Origin validation error in Windows DNS enables network spoofing. Undermining DNS integrity directly facilitates man-in-the-middle attacks and credential harvesting campaigns.
Network Devices.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows DNS enables network spoofing. Undermining DNS integrity directly facilitates man-in-the-middle attacks and credential harvesting campaigns.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中存在源地址验证错误，可导致网络欺骗。DNS 完整性的受损将直接助长中间人攻击及凭据窃取活动。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 8.8 integer overflow in DHCP Server allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening critical network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer overflow in DHCP Server allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening critical network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中存在评分为 8.8 的整数溢出漏洞，可导致未授权的远程代码执行，严重威胁关键网络基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Schannel enables remote code execution over TLS/SSL, impacting secure communications globally.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Schannel enables remote code execution over TLS/SSL, impacting secure communications globally.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Schannel 中存在评分为 8.8 的堆溢出漏洞，可导致基于 TLS/SSL 的远程代码执行，对全球安全通信造成严重影响。

Network Devices.reason: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in DNS Server permits remote code execution, directly compromising name resolution services.
Network Devices.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in DNS Server permits remote code execution, directly compromising name resolution services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在评分为 8.1 的释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏域名解析服务。

Network Devices.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Netlogon permits remote code execution over the network, critically endangering Active Directory authentication and domain controller security.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Netlogon permits remote code execution over the network, critically endangering Active Directory authentication and domain controller security.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon 中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，严重危及 Active Directory 身份验证机制及域控制器的安全性。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution, threatening network address management and overall infrastructure availability.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution, threatening network address management and overall infrastructure availability.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁网络地址管理及整体基础设施的可用性。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in the DNS Server enables remote code execution over the network, risking disruption of critical name resolution services across enterprise environments.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in the DNS Server enables remote code execution over the network, risking disruption of critical name resolution services across enterprise environments.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，可能导致企业环境中的关键域名解析服务中断。

Network Devices.reason: Actively exploited authentication bypass in Ivanti ICS/Policy Secure web interfaces grants unauthorized access to critical network security appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Actively exploited authentication bypass in Ivanti ICS/Policy Secure web interfaces grants unauthorized access to critical network security appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Ivanti ICS/Policy Secure Web 界面中存在已被活跃利用的身份验证绕过漏洞，可使攻击者获得对关键网络安全设备的未授权访问权限。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in Windows DNS Server permits unauthenticated network code execution, threatening core infrastructure name resolution.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DNS Server permits unauthenticated network code execution, threatening core infrastructure name resolution.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中存在竞争条件漏洞，可允许未认证的远程代码执行，严重威胁核心基础设施的域名解析功能。

Network Devices.reason: Session validation weakness in Tenda routers allows unauthenticated DNS configuration changes, enabling widespread traffic interception and MITM attacks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Session validation weakness in Tenda routers allows unauthenticated DNS configuration changes, enabling widespread traffic interception and MITM attacks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Tenda 路由器中存在会话验证缺陷，可导致未授权的 DNS 配置修改，从而引发大规模的流量拦截与中间人（MITM）攻击。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated remote command injection in the orchestrator HTTP service allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary CLI commands on managed switches.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote command injection in the orchestrator HTTP service allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary CLI commands on managed switches.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 编排器 HTTP 服务中存在未认证的远程命令注入漏洞，允许相邻网络攻击者在受管交换机上执行任意 CLI 命令。

Network Devices.reason: Known exploited path traversal vulnerability in FortiMail permits unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files, compromising mail gateway integrity.
Network Devices.reason_en: Known exploited path traversal vulnerability in FortiMail permits unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files, compromising mail gateway integrity.
Network Devices.reason_zh: FortiMail 中存在已知被利用的路径遍历漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者写入任意文件，从而破坏邮件网关的完整性。

Network Devices.reason: Known exploited stack-based buffer overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution on critical secure access gateways and VPN appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Known exploited stack-based buffer overflow enables unauthenticated remote code execution on critical secure access gateways and VPN appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 已知被利用的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在关键安全访问网关及 VPN 设备上实现未认证的远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Authentication bypass via a hardcoded string grants unauthenticated attackers full administrative access to managed industrial Ethernet switches.
Network Devices.reason_en: Authentication bypass via a hardcoded string grants unauthenticated attackers full administrative access to managed industrial Ethernet switches.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 攻击者可通过硬编码字符串绕过身份验证，从而在未认证状态下获取对受管工业以太网交换机的完整管理员权限。

Network Devices.reason: Critical unauthenticated RCE in Progress ADC LoadMaster appliances allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands, completely compromising network traffic management and security policies.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated RCE in Progress ADC LoadMaster appliances allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands, completely compromising network traffic management and security policies.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Progress ADC LoadMaster 设备中存在关键级未授权远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可执行任意命令，从而完全破坏网络流量管理与安全策略。

Network Devices.reason: Command injection via TDDP module allows adjacent attackers to execute root commands on Deco mesh routers, fully compromising home network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Command injection via TDDP module allows adjacent attackers to execute root commands on Deco mesh routers, fully compromising home network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过 TDDP 模块的命令注入漏洞允许相邻攻击者在 Deco 网状路由器上执行 root 权限命令，从而完全破坏家庭网络基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Header name truncation enables HTTP request smuggling and policy bypass, allowing attackers to intercept or manipulate backend traffic undetected.
Network Devices.reason_en: Header name truncation enables HTTP request smuggling and policy bypass, allowing attackers to intercept or manipulate backend traffic undetected.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 头部名称截断漏洞可导致 HTTP 请求走私与策略绕过，使攻击者能够隐蔽地拦截或篡改后端流量。

Network Devices.reason: Exposed internal SOAP endpoint allows unauthenticated invocation of administrative functions, enabling complete takeover of Genian NAC/ZTNA policy servers.
Network Devices.reason_en: Exposed internal SOAP endpoint allows unauthenticated invocation of administrative functions, enabling complete takeover of Genian NAC/ZTNA policy servers.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 暴露的内部 SOAP 端点允许未授权调用管理功能，从而导致 Genian NAC/ZTNA 策略服务器被完全接管。

Network Devices.reason: Remote unauthenticated attackers can trigger a denial of service on integrated web servers by exploiting missing HTTP(S) content validation, impacting management plane availability for enterprise switching infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote unauthenticated attackers can trigger a denial of service on integrated web servers by exploiting missing HTTP(S) content validation, impacting management plane availability for enterprise switching infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 远程未授权攻击者可通过利用缺失的 HTTP(S) 内容验证在集成 Web 服务器上触发拒绝服务，进而影响企业交换基础设施管理平面的可用性。

Network Devices.reason: iperf3 UDP receive worker enters an unrecoverable infinite loop upon receiving crafted control messages, causing persistent denial of service in network testing gear.
Network Devices.reason_en: iperf3 UDP receive worker enters an unrecoverable infinite loop upon receiving crafted control messages, causing persistent denial of service in network testing gear.
Network Devices.reason_zh: iperf3 的 UDP 接收工作进程在接收到构造的控制消息后会进入不可恢复的无限循环，导致网络测试设备出现持续性拒绝服务。

Network Devices.reason: D-Link DSL-124 ME configuration backup disclosure exposes complete router settings including credentials via unauthenticated POST requests.
Network Devices.reason_en: D-Link DSL-124 ME configuration backup disclosure exposes complete router settings including credentials via unauthenticated POST requests.
Network Devices.reason_zh: D-Link DSL-124 ME 的配置备份泄露漏洞允许通过未授权的 POST 请求获取包含凭据在内的完整路由器配置。

Network Devices.reason: Netcore POWER13 router suffers a weak password recovery mechanism, allowing remote attackers to bypass authentication and reset administrative credentials.
Network Devices.reason_en: Netcore POWER13 router suffers a weak password recovery mechanism, allowing remote attackers to bypass authentication and reset administrative credentials.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Netcore POWER13 路由器存在弱密码恢复机制缺陷，允许远程攻击者绕过身份验证并重置管理员凭据。

Network Devices.reason: Critical remote OS command injection in Netcore router CGI handlers allows full device compromise, enabling attackers to reconfigure routing, intercept traffic, and pivot to internal networks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical remote OS command injection in Netcore router CGI handlers allows full device compromise, enabling attackers to reconfigure routing, intercept traffic, and pivot to internal networks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Netcore 路由器 CGI 处理程序中存在关键级远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，可导致设备被完全控制，使攻击者能够重新配置路由、拦截流量并横向渗透至内部网络。

Network Devices.reason: Missing authorization in the router's ACL handler permits unauthenticated modification of network access policies, leading to traffic manipulation and potential network segmentation breaches.
Network Devices.reason_en: Missing authorization in the router's ACL handler permits unauthenticated modification of network access policies, leading to traffic manipulation and potential network segmentation breaches.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 路由器 ACL 处理程序缺乏授权检查，允许未授权修改网络访问策略，从而导致流量篡改及潜在的网络分段边界突破。

Network Devices.reason: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in the FAST router's discovery service enables arbitrary code execution, completely compromising network infrastructure hardware.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in the FAST router's discovery service enables arbitrary code execution, completely compromising network infrastructure hardware.
Network Devices.reason_zh: FAST 路由器发现服务中存在远程基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致任意代码执行，从而完全破坏网络基础设施硬件。

Network Devices.reason: Improper authentication in the Netcore CGI dispatcher allows unauthenticated remote access to administrative functions, significantly increasing the attack surface for network equipment.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper authentication in the Netcore CGI dispatcher allows unauthenticated remote access to administrative functions, significantly increasing the attack surface for network equipment.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Netcore CGI 分发器存在认证缺陷，允许未授权远程访问管理功能，显著扩大了网络设备的攻击面。

Network Devices.reason: Actively exploited in the wild, this URI encoding flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass session authentication and gain full administrative control.
Network Devices.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild, this URI encoding flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass session authentication and gain full administrative control.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 该 URI 编码缺陷已在野外被活跃利用，允许未授权远程攻击者绕过会话认证并获取完全的管理控制权。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated adjacent attackers can inject commands via the CLI interface, leading to complete device compromise without prior credentials.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated adjacent attackers can inject commands via the CLI interface, leading to complete device compromise without prior credentials.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 未授权的相邻攻击者可通过 CLI 接口注入命令，在无需预先凭据的情况下实现设备的完全控制。

Network Devices.reason: A stack-based buffer overflow in the management interface enables unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise network appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the management interface enables unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise network appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 管理界面中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在企业网络设备上实现未授权远程代码执行。

Network Devices.reason: Adjacent network attackers can trigger a buffer overflow in the DHCP fingerprinting daemon to achieve arbitrary code execution on firewalls.
Network Devices.reason_en: Adjacent network attackers can trigger a buffer overflow in the DHCP fingerprinting daemon to achieve arbitrary code execution on firewalls.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 相邻网络攻击者可触发 DHCP 指纹识别守护进程的缓冲区溢出，从而在防火墙上实现任意代码执行。

Industrial Control.reason: Hardcoded cryptographic key in Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 facilitates extraction of embedded sensitive operational data from building controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Hardcoded cryptographic key in Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 facilitates extraction of embedded sensitive operational data from building controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 中的硬编码加密密钥使得攻击者能够从楼宇控制器中提取嵌入式敏感操作数据。

Industrial Control.reason: OS command injection in Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on industrial controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_en: OS command injection in Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on industrial controllers.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Johnson Controls EasyIO FS32 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在工业控制器上执行任意系统命令。

Industrial Control.reason: Exposed on-chip debug interface in Johnson Controls Neo Series MVP2 allows collection of sensitive data from common resource locations.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Exposed on-chip debug interface in Johnson Controls Neo Series MVP2 allows collection of sensitive data from common resource locations.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Johnson Controls Neo Series MVP2 暴露的片上调试接口允许从常见资源位置收集敏感数据。

Industrial Control.reason: Path traversal in dynamically created BACnet file objects allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read or overwrite arbitrary device files.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Path traversal in dynamically created BACnet file objects allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read or overwrite arbitrary device files.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 动态创建的 BACnet 文件对象存在路径遍历漏洞，允许未授权远程攻击者读取或覆盖任意设备文件。

Industrial Control.reason: Improper privilege management in the VxWorks command shell allows authenticated users to bypass security checks and execute restricted commands.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Improper privilege management in the VxWorks command shell allows authenticated users to bypass security checks and execute restricted commands.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: VxWorks 命令 Shell 中权限管理不当，允许已认证用户绕过安全检查并执行受限命令。

Industrial Control.reason: Write protection bypass in the CANopen SDO server implementation enables unauthenticated attackers on the bus to modify critical device configurations.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Write protection bypass in the CANopen SDO server implementation enables unauthenticated attackers on the bus to modify critical device configurations.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: CANopen SDO 服务器实现中的写保护绕过漏洞，使总线上的未授权攻击者能够修改关键设备配置。

Industrial Control.reason: Hidden functionality and hardcoded credentials in Hitachi coding software allow unauthorized access, posing severe risks to industrial automation and manufacturing systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Hidden functionality and hardcoded credentials in Hitachi coding software allow unauthorized access, posing severe risks to industrial automation and manufacturing systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Hitachi 编程软件中存在隐藏功能与硬编码凭据，可导致未授权访问，对工业自动化与制造系统构成严重风险。

Industrial Control.reason: Hardcoded JWT signing secret allows token forgery, enabling attackers to authenticate as administrators and manipulate industrial software configurations.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT signing secret allows token forgery, enabling attackers to authenticate as administrators and manipulate industrial software configurations.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 硬编码的 JWT 签名密钥可导致令牌伪造，使攻击者能够冒充管理员身份并操纵工业软件配置。

Industrial Control.reason: Path traversal vulnerability allows attackers to access, modify, or delete arbitrary files in Hitachi coding software, compromising industrial development environments.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows attackers to access, modify, or delete arbitrary files in Hitachi coding software, compromising industrial development environments.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者在 Hitachi 编程软件中访问、修改或删除任意文件，从而破坏工业开发环境。

Industrial Control.reason: NASA AMMOS Instrument Toolkit lacks authentication for session creation, allowing remote attackers to issue arbitrary spacecraft commands without credentials.
Industrial Control.reason_en: NASA AMMOS Instrument Toolkit lacks authentication for session creation, allowing remote attackers to issue arbitrary spacecraft commands without credentials.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: NASA AMMOS Instrument Toolkit 在创建会话时缺乏身份验证，允许远程攻击者在无需凭据的情况下下发任意航天器指令。

Industrial Control.reason: Belden HiSecOS privilege escalation via XML NETCONF payloads lets operators elevate to administrators, undermining industrial network segmentation and safety controls.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Belden HiSecOS privilege escalation via XML NETCONF payloads lets operators elevate to administrators, undermining industrial network segmentation and safety controls.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 通过 XML NETCONF 有效载荷，Belden HiSecOS 存在权限提升漏洞，可使操作员提权至管理员，从而破坏工业网络分段与安全控制。

Industrial Control.reason: HiSecOS web server role manipulation enables auditor/operator accounts to gain full administrative privileges, risking critical infrastructure management interfaces.
Industrial Control.reason_en: HiSecOS web server role manipulation enables auditor/operator accounts to gain full administrative privileges, risking critical infrastructure management interfaces.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: HiSecOS Web 服务器的角色操纵漏洞可使审计员或操作员账户获取完全管理权限，危及关键基础设施管理界面。

Web Security.reason: Foreman's template preview endpoint suffers from SSRF and multi-stage template injection, allowing remote command execution. Directly impacts web-facing IT automation dashboards.
Web Security.reason_en: Foreman's template preview endpoint suffers from SSRF and multi-stage template injection, allowing remote command execution. Directly impacts web-facing IT automation dashboards.
Web Security.reason_zh: Foreman 的模板预览端点存在 SSRF 与多阶段模板注入漏洞，可导致远程命令执行，直接影响面向 Web 的 IT 自动化仪表板。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in ClipBucket's admin panel allows authenticated users to extract or modify database contents. Highlights ongoing risks in video hosting platform administration interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in ClipBucket's admin panel allows authenticated users to extract or modify database contents. Highlights ongoing risks in video hosting platform administration interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: ClipBucket 管理面板中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许已认证用户提取或修改数据库内容，凸显了视频托管平台管理界面持续存在的安全风险。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js enables token spoofing over the network. Compromises modern web application identity flows and session integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js enables token spoofing over the network. Compromises modern web application identity flows and session integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: MSAL for Node.js 中的捕获重放导致身份验证绕过，可在网络中实现令牌伪造。破坏了现代 Web 应用的身份流程与会话完整性。

Web Security.reason: Permits unauthenticated code execution on Microsoft SharePoint servers, directly impacting web-based collaboration platforms and risking complete data breach.
Web Security.reason_en: Permits unauthenticated code execution on Microsoft SharePoint servers, directly impacting web-based collaboration platforms and risking complete data breach.
Web Security.reason_zh: 允许在 Microsoft SharePoint 服务器上执行未认证代码，直接影响基于 Web 的协作平台，并可能导致数据完全泄露。

Web Security.reason: Enables cross-site scripting attacks against SharePoint portals, facilitating session hijacking, credential harvesting, and malicious content injection for end users.
Web Security.reason_en: Enables cross-site scripting attacks against SharePoint portals, facilitating session hijacking, credential harvesting, and malicious content injection for end users.
Web Security.reason_zh: 允许针对 SharePoint 门户实施跨站脚本攻击，便于对终端用户进行会话劫持、凭证窃取和恶意内容注入。

Web Security.reason: Highlights excessive default permissions in SharePoint services, increasing the blast radius of compromised accounts and amplifying internal threat scenarios.
Web Security.reason_en: Highlights excessive default permissions in SharePoint services, increasing the blast radius of compromised accounts and amplifying internal threat scenarios.
Web Security.reason_zh: 揭示了 SharePoint 服务中默认权限过高的问题，扩大了已失陷账户的影响范围，并加剧了内部威胁场景。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) allows remote code execution, targeting the primary web browsing attack surface.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium) allows remote code execution, targeting the primary web browsing attack surface.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (Chromium) 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的堆溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接针对主要的 Web 浏览攻击面。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.2 HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code bypasses security controls, affecting developer toolchains and web proxies.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code bypasses security controls, affecting developer toolchains and web proxies.
Web Security.reason_zh: VS Code 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.2 的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞，可绕过安全控制，影响开发者工具链和 Web 代理。

Web Security.reason: CVSS 8.2 SSRF in VS Code enables unauthorized feature bypass, facilitating internal network reconnaissance via development environments.
Web Security.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 SSRF in VS Code enables unauthorized feature bypass, facilitating internal network reconnaissance via development environments.
Web Security.reason_zh: VS Code 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.2 的 SSRF 漏洞，可实现未授权的功能绕过，便于通过开发环境进行内网探测。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows privilege escalation over the network, severely impacting enterprise email infrastructure security.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows privilege escalation over the network, severely impacting enterprise email infrastructure security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中存在缺失授权检查的问题，允许通过网络提升权限，严重危及企业电子邮件基础设施的安全。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing attacks with a CVSS of 9.3, exploiting web-facing mail interfaces for credential theft or redirection.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables network-based spoofing attacks with a CVSS of 9.3, exploiting web-facing mail interfaces for credential theft or redirection.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞 CVSS 评分为 9.3，可利用面向 Web 的邮件接口实施网络欺骗攻击，以窃取凭证或进行流量重定向。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft SharePoint allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, exposing collaborative web platforms to data exfiltration and takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft SharePoint allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, exposing collaborative web platforms to data exfiltration and takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络提升权限，使协作 Web 平台面临数据外泄和被接管的风险。

Web Security.reason: Actively exploited unauthenticated RCE in Oracle WebLogic Server continues to threaten legacy enterprise web applications and middleware deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Actively exploited unauthenticated RCE in Oracle WebLogic Server continues to threaten legacy enterprise web applications and middleware deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Oracle WebLogic Server 中正在被利用的未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，持续威胁遗留企业 Web 应用及中间件部署。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Grav CMS scheduler-webhook plugin allows unauthenticated remote access when token validation is misconfigured.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Grav CMS scheduler-webhook plugin allows unauthenticated remote access when token validation is misconfigured.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav CMS 的 scheduler-webhook 插件存在身份验证绕过漏洞，当令牌验证配置错误时，允许未认证的远程访问。

Web Security.reason: Zip Slip path traversal in WordPress Prime Mover plugin enables authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files outside intended directories.
Web Security.reason_en: Zip Slip path traversal in WordPress Prime Mover plugin enables authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files outside intended directories.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress Prime Mover 插件中存在 Zip Slip 路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证的管理员向预期目录之外写入任意文件。

Web Security.reason: Known exploited remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server poses a severe threat to enterprise email infrastructure and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_en: Known exploited remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server poses a severe threat to enterprise email infrastructure and data confidentiality.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中已知遭利用的远程代码执行漏洞，对企业电子邮件基础设施和数据机密性构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution via an unprotected API endpoint allows attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands on AI inference platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via an unprotected API endpoint allows attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands on AI inference platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过未受保护的 API 端点实现的未认证远程代码执行，允许攻击者在 AI 推理平台上执行任意操作系统命令。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe ZIP extraction in the update handler downloads and extracts unvalidated archives directly into the web root, enabling complete site takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe ZIP extraction in the update handler downloads and extracts unvalidated archives directly into the web root, enabling complete site takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: 更新处理程序中存在不安全的 ZIP 解压逻辑，会下载并直接将未经验证的压缩包解压至网站根目录，从而导致站点被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: Known exploited SVG-based cross-site scripting vulnerability compromises webmail client sessions and enables credential harvesting.
Web Security.reason_en: Known exploited SVG-based cross-site scripting vulnerability compromises webmail client sessions and enables credential harvesting.
Web Security.reason_zh: 已知遭利用的基于 SVG 的跨站脚本漏洞会破坏 Web 邮件客户端会话，并支持凭证窃取。

Web Security.reason: Critical authentication bypass allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrative access to PaperCut NG, directly impacting print security and potentially enabling data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrative access to PaperCut NG, directly impacting print security and potentially enabling data exfiltration.
Web Security.reason_zh: 关键的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者获取 PaperCut NG 的管理员访问权限，直接影响打印安全性，并可能导致数据外泄。

Web Security.reason: Unrestricted deserialization in WordPress Fusion Builder allows object injection, potentially leading to remote code execution on affected websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Unrestricted deserialization in WordPress Fusion Builder allows object injection, potentially leading to remote code execution on affected websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress Fusion Builder 中存在不受限制的反序列化漏洞，允许对象注入，可能导致受影响网站发生远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Disables TLS certificate validation for WebSocket connections in GraphQL tools, exposing applications to man-in-the-middle attacks and credential theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Disables TLS certificate validation for WebSocket connections in GraphQL tools, exposing applications to man-in-the-middle attacks and credential theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: GraphQL 工具禁用了 WebSocket 连接的 TLS 证书验证，使应用程序暴露于中间人攻击和凭证窃取风险之下。

Web Security.reason: PHP object injection in WooCommerce shipping plugin enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to take full control of e-commerce storefronts.
Web Security.reason_en: PHP object injection in WooCommerce shipping plugin enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to take full control of e-commerce storefronts.
Web Security.reason_zh: WooCommerce 发货插件中的 PHP 对象注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，使攻击者能够完全控制电子商务前台。

Web Security.reason: The two-factor authentication verification flaw accepts reused time-based one-time passwords within their validity window, undermining account security and risking exposure of sensitive threat intelligence data.
Web Security.reason_en: The two-factor authentication verification flaw accepts reused time-based one-time passwords within their validity window, undermining account security and risking exposure of sensitive threat intelligence data.
Web Security.reason_zh: 双因素身份验证验证缺陷接受在其有效窗口期内重复使用的基于时间的一次性密码，削弱了账户安全性，并可能导致敏感威胁情报数据泄露。

Web Security.reason: ICEcoder unauthenticated remote code execution chains authentication and CSRF bypasses with unsanitized command execution, fully compromising web hosting panels.
Web Security.reason_en: ICEcoder unauthenticated remote code execution chains authentication and CSRF bypasses with unsanitized command execution, fully compromising web hosting panels.
Web Security.reason_zh: ICEcoder 的未认证远程代码执行漏洞将身份验证绕过与 CSRF 绕过相结合，并通过未过滤的命令执行，彻底攻破 Web 主机管理面板。

Web Security.reason: phpIPAM REST API authentication bypass via insecure cache keying grants full unauthenticated programmatic access to IP address management data.
Web Security.reason_en: phpIPAM REST API authentication bypass via insecure cache keying grants full unauthenticated programmatic access to IP address management data.
Web Security.reason_zh: phpIPAM REST API 因不安全的缓存键机制导致身份验证绕过，授予对 IP 地址管理数据的完全未认证编程访问权限。

Web Security.reason: n8n stored DOM XSS in workflow link handling enables session hijacking and administrator account takeover within automation dashboards.
Web Security.reason_en: n8n stored DOM XSS in workflow link handling enables session hijacking and administrator account takeover within automation dashboards.
Web Security.reason_zh: n8n 在工作流链接处理中存在存储型 DOM XSS 漏洞，可导致自动化仪表板内的会话劫持和管理员账户接管。

Web Security.reason: PyJWT asymmetric-key guard flaw allows algorithm substitution attacks when mixing HMAC and asymmetric tokens, breaking authentication integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: PyJWT asymmetric-key guard flaw allows algorithm substitution attacks when mixing HMAC and asymmetric tokens, breaking authentication integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: PyJWT 的非对称密钥保护缺陷在混合使用 HMAC 和非对称令牌时允许算法替换攻击，破坏身份验证完整性。

Web Security.reason: Privilege escalation in Super Forms allows attackers to manipulate client-submitted role keys, elevating their privileges to administrator level and gaining full WordPress site control.
Web Security.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Super Forms allows attackers to manipulate client-submitted role keys, elevating their privileges to administrator level and gaining full WordPress site control.
Web Security.reason_zh: Super Forms 中的权限提升漏洞允许攻击者操纵客户端提交的角色密钥，将其权限提升至管理员级别，从而获得完整的 WordPress 站点控制权。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in the Multisite SaaS plugin exploits checkout flow flaws, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass login requirements and compromise platform security.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the Multisite SaaS plugin exploits checkout flow flaws, allowing unauthenticated users to bypass login requirements and compromise platform security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Multisite SaaS 插件中的身份验证绕过漏洞利用了结账流程缺陷，允许未认证用户绕过登录要求，从而破坏平台安全性。

Web Security.reason: Exploitation of trusted identifiers in the PayTR WHMCS module allows attackers to bypass security checks in payment processing workflows, risking financial data integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Exploitation of trusted identifiers in the PayTR WHMCS module allows attackers to bypass security checks in payment processing workflows, risking financial data integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: PayTR WHMCS 模块中对可信标识符的利用允许攻击者绕过支付处理工作流中的安全检查，危及财务数据完整性。

Web Security.reason: Account takeover vulnerability in WPC Shop allows attackers to bypass role validation during session issuance, compromising e-commerce customer accounts and platform trust.
Web Security.reason_en: Account takeover vulnerability in WPC Shop allows attackers to bypass role validation during session issuance, compromising e-commerce customer accounts and platform trust.
Web Security.reason_zh: WPC Shop 中的账户接管漏洞允许攻击者在会话发放期间绕过角色验证，损害电子商务客户账户及平台信任度。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass in Ghost allows suspended staff users to reactivate accounts via self-service password reset, regaining active access and bypassing suspension controls.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Ghost allows suspended staff users to reactivate accounts via self-service password reset, regaining active access and bypassing suspension controls.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许被暂停的员工用户通过自助密码重置功能重新激活账户，恢复活跃访问权限并绕过暂停控制。

Web Security.reason: Improper session handling in Ghost enables staff users to log in as others using only passwords, effectively bypassing two-factor authentication and compromising user accounts.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper session handling in Ghost enables staff users to log in as others using only passwords, effectively bypassing two-factor authentication and compromising user accounts.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost中不当的会话处理机制使员工用户仅凭密码即可冒充他人登录，有效绕过双因素认证并导致用户账户受损。

Web Security.reason: XSS vulnerability in Ghost's JSON-LD HTML tag injection allows attackers to execute malicious scripts on published pages, affecting visitor browsers and SEO integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: XSS vulnerability in Ghost's JSON-LD HTML tag injection allows attackers to execute malicious scripts on published pages, affecting visitor browsers and SEO integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost的JSON-LD HTML标签注入存在XSS漏洞，攻击者可在已发布页面上执行恶意脚本，影响访客浏览器及SEO完整性。

Web Security.reason: Content API bypass in Ghost allows unauthenticated visitors to directly query and retrieve gated post content, breaking paywall and membership restrictions.
Web Security.reason_en: Content API bypass in Ghost allows unauthenticated visitors to directly query and retrieve gated post content, breaking paywall and membership restrictions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost的内容API绕过漏洞允许未认证访客直接查询和获取受限文章内容，破坏付费墙和会员限制。

Web Security.reason: Abuse of Stripe Checkout flows in Ghost enables attackers to attach subscriptions to existing members, modify names, and inject content into newsletters, compromising user trust.
Web Security.reason_en: Abuse of Stripe Checkout flows in Ghost enables attackers to attach subscriptions to existing members, modify names, and inject content into newsletters, compromising user trust.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost中滥用Stripe Checkout流程使攻击者能够将订阅关联至现有会员、修改名称并向通讯邮件注入内容，损害用户信任。

Web Security.reason: Cross-Site Request Forgery in Memberful allows attackers to trick authenticated users into performing unintended membership actions, disrupting subscription management workflows.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-Site Request Forgery in Memberful allows attackers to trick authenticated users into performing unintended membership actions, disrupting subscription management workflows.
Web Security.reason_zh: Memberful中存在跨站请求伪造（CSRF）漏洞，攻击者可诱骗已认证用户执行非预期的会员操作，破坏订阅管理工作流。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in Unlimited Elements For Elementor allows attackers to extract sensitive WordPress database contents without direct error feedback, risking data breaches.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Unlimited Elements For Elementor allows attackers to extract sensitive WordPress database contents without direct error feedback, risking data breaches.
Web Security.reason_zh: Unlimited Elements For Elementor中存在盲注SQL注入漏洞，攻击者无需直接错误反馈即可提取敏感的WordPress数据库内容，存在数据泄露风险。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in VillaTheme BuildKit exposes WooCommerce product builder forms to unauthorized data extraction and database manipulation.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in VillaTheme BuildKit exposes WooCommerce product builder forms to unauthorized data extraction and database manipulation.
Web Security.reason_zh: VillaTheme BuildKit中存在盲注SQL注入漏洞，导致WooCommerce产品构建表单暴露于未授权的数据提取和数据库篡改风险中。

Web Security.reason: OS command injection in aaPanel's unzip handler allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, compromising entire web hosting environments and server infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: OS command injection in aaPanel's unzip handler allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, compromising entire web hosting environments and server infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: aaPanel的解压处理器中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，攻击者可执行任意系统命令，危及整个虚拟主机环境及服务器基础设施。

Web Security.reason: Prototype pollution in Axios HTTP client allows attackers to modify object behavior, potentially leading to remote code execution or denial of service in Node.js web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Prototype pollution in Axios HTTP client allows attackers to modify object behavior, potentially leading to remote code execution or denial of service in Node.js web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Axios HTTP客户端存在原型链污染漏洞，攻击者可修改对象行为，可能导致Node.js Web应用中的远程代码执行或拒绝服务。

Web Security.reason: Inadequate error handling during HTTP/2 session initialization in Axios can cause crashes or unexpected behavior, impacting web application availability and stability.
Web Security.reason_en: Inadequate error handling during HTTP/2 session initialization in Axios can cause crashes or unexpected behavior, impacting web application availability and stability.
Web Security.reason_zh: Axios在HTTP/2会话初始化期间缺乏适当的错误处理，可能导致崩溃或异常行为，影响Web应用的可用性与稳定性。

Web Security.reason: Authorization bypass in Obot allows basic-role users to proxy requests through restricted routes, invoking tools and escalating privileges within the web platform.
Web Security.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Obot allows basic-role users to proxy requests through restricted routes, invoking tools and escalating privileges within the web platform.
Web Security.reason_zh: Obot中存在授权绕过漏洞，基础角色用户可通过受限路由代理请求，调用工具并在Web平台内提升权限。

Web Security.reason: Authorization bypass in Budibase AI table generation allows authenticated users to conduct SSRF attacks via raw fetch calls, probing internal networks and accessing restricted resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Budibase AI table generation allows authenticated users to conduct SSRF attacks via raw fetch calls, probing internal networks and accessing restricted resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Budibase AI表生成中存在授权绕过漏洞，已认证用户可通过原始fetch调用发起SSRF攻击，探测内部网络并访问受限资源。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in JetBrains YouTrack allows authenticated users to add themselves to restricted project teams, bypassing access controls and viewing confidential issues.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in JetBrains YouTrack allows authenticated users to add themselves to restricted project teams, bypassing access controls and viewing confidential issues.
Web Security.reason_zh: JetBrains YouTrack中存在缺失授权检查的漏洞，已认证用户可将自身添加至受限项目团队，绕过访问控制并查看机密问题。

Web Security.reason: Privilege escalation via user group links in YouTrack grants unauthorized users elevated permissions, breaking project management security boundaries.
Web Security.reason_en: Privilege escalation via user group links in YouTrack grants unauthorized users elevated permissions, breaking project management security boundaries.
Web Security.reason_zh: YouTrack中通过用户组链接可实现权限提升，使未授权用户获得更高权限，破坏项目管理安全边界。

Web Security.reason: Same-process prototype pollution in Axios places functions on Object.prototype, potentially bypassing security controls and leading to arbitrary code execution in web stacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Same-process prototype pollution in Axios places functions on Object.prototype, potentially bypassing security controls and leading to arbitrary code execution in web stacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Axios的同进程原型链污染漏洞将函数挂载至Object.prototype，可能绕过安全控制并在Web技术栈中导致任意代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Bypassed SSRF denylist in fast-mcp-telegram allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate data through compromised Telegram bot integrations.
Web Security.reason_en: Bypassed SSRF denylist in fast-mcp-telegram allows attackers to probe internal networks and exfiltrate data through compromised Telegram bot integrations.
Web Security.reason_zh: fast-mcp-telegram中被绕过的SSRF黑名单允许攻击者探测内部网络，并通过被入侵的Telegram机器人集成窃取数据。

Web Security.reason: Input validation flaw in Ghost's admin iframe enables attackers to craft malicious pages that hijack staff user sessions when visited, compromising CMS administration.
Web Security.reason_en: Input validation flaw in Ghost's admin iframe enables attackers to craft malicious pages that hijack staff user sessions when visited, compromising CMS administration.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ghost的管理员iframe存在输入验证缺陷，攻击者可构造恶意页面，在用户访问时劫持员工会话，危及CMS管理后台。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated stored XSS in Premmerce Wishlist allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in victims' browsers, stealing cookies or performing unauthorized actions.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated stored XSS in Premmerce Wishlist allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in victims' browsers, stealing cookies or performing unauthorized actions.
