Web Security.reason_zh: Premmerce Wishlist中存在未认证的存储型XSS漏洞，攻击者可在受害者浏览器中执行恶意脚本，窃取Cookie或执行未授权操作。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated broken access control in WP Full Stripe Free allows unrestricted administrative actions, compromising site integrity and payment configurations.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated broken access control in WP Full Stripe Free allows unrestricted administrative actions, compromising site integrity and payment configurations.
Web Security.reason_zh: WP Full Stripe Free中存在未认证的越权访问漏洞，允许无限制的后台管理操作，危及网站完整性与支付配置。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in the AI Engine WordPress plugin enables attackers to execute malicious scripts via REST endpoints, compromising user sessions and site functionality.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in the AI Engine WordPress plugin enables attackers to execute malicious scripts via REST endpoints, compromising user sessions and site functionality.
Web Security.reason_zh: AI Engine WordPress插件中存在存储型XSS漏洞，攻击者可通过REST端点执行恶意脚本，危及用户会话及网站功能。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Forminator Forms allows attackers to inject malicious scripts via unsanitized form parameters, hijacking administrator accounts or defacing websites.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Forminator Forms allows attackers to inject malicious scripts via unsanitized form parameters, hijacking administrator accounts or defacing websites.
Web Security.reason_zh: Forminator Forms中存在存储型XSS漏洞，攻击者可通过未过滤的表单参数注入恶意脚本，劫持管理员账号或篡改网站页面。

Web Security.reason: Stored DOM-based XSS in Booking Calendar triggers malicious script execution in victim browsers without server-side filtering, impacting appointment scheduling platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored DOM-based XSS in Booking Calendar triggers malicious script execution in victim browsers without server-side filtering, impacting appointment scheduling platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Booking Calendar中存在存储型DOM型XSS漏洞，由于缺乏服务端过滤，会在受害者浏览器中触发恶意脚本执行，影响预约调度平台。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in PDF Invoices & Packing Slips allows script injection via billing fields, compromising WooCommerce store administrators and customer data.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in PDF Invoices & Packing Slips allows script injection via billing fields, compromising WooCommerce store administrators and customer data.
Web Security.reason_zh: PDF Invoices & Packing Slips中存在存储型XSS漏洞，攻击者可通过账单字段注入脚本，危及WooCommerce商店管理员及客户数据。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in Autoptimize via REQUEST_URI path injection enables attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of affected WordPress sites.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in Autoptimize via REQUEST_URI path injection enables attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of affected WordPress sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: Autoptimize中通过REQUEST_URI路径注入存在存储型XSS漏洞，使攻击者能在受影响WordPress站点上下文中执行恶意脚本。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in Ultimate Member allows attackers to extract sensitive user data from WordPress databases without direct query feedback.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Ultimate Member allows attackers to extract sensitive user data from WordPress databases without direct query feedback.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ultimate Member中存在盲注SQL注入漏洞，攻击者无需直接查询反馈即可从WordPress数据库中提取敏感用户数据。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in CloudClassroom-PHP-Project enables attackers to manipulate database queries, potentially exposing sensitive educational data or altering records.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in CloudClassroom-PHP-Project enables attackers to manipulate database queries, potentially exposing sensitive educational data or altering records.
Web Security.reason_zh: CloudClassroom-PHP-Project中存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可操纵数据库查询，可能导致敏感教育数据泄露或记录被篡改。

Web Security.reason: Input data manipulation in PayTR Virtual Pos WHMCS module allows attackers to alter payment quantities, causing financial discrepancies or transaction fraud.
Web Security.reason_en: Input data manipulation in PayTR Virtual Pos WHMCS module allows attackers to alter payment quantities, causing financial discrepancies or transaction fraud.
Web Security.reason_zh: PayTR Virtual Pos WHMCS模块中存在输入数据篡改漏洞，攻击者可修改支付数量，导致财务差异或交易欺诈。

Web Security.reason: Observable timing discrepancy in PayTR modules enables black-box reverse engineering of cryptographic operations, potentially weakening payment authentication mechanisms.
Web Security.reason_en: Observable timing discrepancy in PayTR modules enables black-box reverse engineering of cryptographic operations, potentially weakening payment authentication mechanisms.
Web Security.reason_zh: PayTR模块中存在可观测的时序差异漏洞，支持对加密操作进行黑盒逆向工程，可能削弱支付认证机制的安全性。

Web Security.reason: Stored XSS in 10Web Form Maker via map coordinates allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in affected WordPress sites, compromising user interactions.
Web Security.reason_en: Stored XSS in 10Web Form Maker via map coordinates allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in affected WordPress sites, compromising user interactions.
Web Security.reason_zh: 10Web Form Maker中通过地图坐标存在存储型XSS漏洞，使攻击者能在受影响的WordPress站点中执行恶意脚本，危及用户交互。

Web Security.reason: Arbitrary file and directory deletion in Super Forms lacks capability checks, allowing subscriber-level users to cause denial of service or destabilize WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_en: Arbitrary file and directory deletion in Super Forms lacks capability checks, allowing subscriber-level users to cause denial of service or destabilize WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_zh: Super Forms 中的任意文件和目录删除漏洞缺乏权限检查，允许订阅者级别的用户导致拒绝服务或破坏 WordPress 安装环境。

Web Security.reason: Unbounded memory accumulation in Tornado's AsyncHTTPClient allows denial of service via gzip decompression bombs, exhausting server resources and impacting web availability.
Web Security.reason_en: Unbounded memory accumulation in Tornado's AsyncHTTPClient allows denial of service via gzip decompression bombs, exhausting server resources and impacting web availability.
Web Security.reason_zh: Tornado 的 AsyncHTTPClient 存在无界内存累积问题，攻击者可利用 gzip 解压炸弹导致拒绝服务，耗尽服务器资源并影响 Web 可用性。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated RCE via PHP code injection in public form submissions poses a critical threat to Joomla-based websites and data integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE via PHP code injection in public form submissions poses a critical threat to Joomla-based websites and data integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过公开表单提交进行 PHP 代码注入可实现未授权远程代码执行（RCE），对基于 Joomla 的网站及数据完整性构成严重威胁。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated path traversal allows attackers to exfiltrate sensitive local files through manipulated form attachments, bypassing standard upload restrictions.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal allows attackers to exfiltrate sensitive local files through manipulated form attachments, bypassing standard upload restrictions.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未授权的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者通过篡改表单附件窃取敏感本地文件，从而绕过标准上传限制。

Web Security.reason: CRLF injection in Git connection settings enables authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands on underlying Windows CI/CD servers.
Web Security.reason_en: CRLF injection in Git connection settings enables authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands on underlying Windows CI/CD servers.
Web Security.reason_zh: Git 连接设置中的 CRLF 注入漏洞可使已认证用户在底层 Windows CI/CD 服务器上执行任意命令。

Web Security.reason: Sandbox escape via versioned settings Kotlin DSL grants attackers unrestricted code execution within the development platform environment.
Web Security.reason_en: Sandbox escape via versioned settings Kotlin DSL grants attackers unrestricted code execution within the development platform environment.
Web Security.reason_zh: 通过版本化配置的 Kotlin DSL 可实现沙箱逃逸，使攻击者在开发平台环境中获得无限制的代码执行权限。

Web Security.reason: Improper user capability checks allow unauthenticated users to escalate privileges and modify other user metadata in widely deployed WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper user capability checks allow unauthenticated users to escalate privileges and modify other user metadata in widely deployed WordPress installations.
Web Security.reason_zh: 不当的用户权限检查机制允许未认证用户在广泛部署的 WordPress 环境中提权并修改其他用户的元数据。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Flaw in 389-ds-base LDAP server allows plaintext message injection during StartTLS negotiation. Undermines directory service security and facilitates man-in-the-middle attacks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Flaw in 389-ds-base LDAP server allows plaintext message injection during StartTLS negotiation. Undermines directory service security and facilitates man-in-the-middle attacks.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 389-ds-base LDAP 服务器存在缺陷，允许在 StartTLS 协商期间注入明文消息。该漏洞破坏了目录服务安全性并助长中间人攻击。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network. Directly compromises primary enterprise relational database engines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution over the network. Directly compromises primary enterprise relational database engines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过网络实现远程代码执行，直接危及核心企业级关系型数据库引擎。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Authenticated low-privilege user can achieve RCE in Foreman by bypassing the Safemode sandbox. Impacts configuration management and orchestration middleware pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Authenticated low-privilege user can achieve RCE in Foreman by bypassing the Safemode sandbox. Impacts configuration management and orchestration middleware pipelines.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 已认证的低权限用户可通过绕过 Safemode 沙箱在 Foreman 中实现远程代码执行（RCE），影响配置管理与编排中间件流水线。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Allows authenticated attackers to inject malicious SQL commands, risking complete database compromise, sensitive data exfiltration, and privilege escalation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Allows authenticated attackers to inject malicious SQL commands, risking complete database compromise, sensitive data exfiltration, and privilege escalation.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许已认证攻击者注入恶意 SQL 命令，可能导致数据库被完全控制、敏感数据泄露及权限提升。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Exploits unsafe object deserialization in SQL Server, enabling remote code execution without requiring additional complex authentication vectors.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Exploits unsafe object deserialization in SQL Server, enabling remote code execution without requiring additional complex authentication vectors.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 利用 SQL Server 中不安全的对象反序列化漏洞，可在无需额外复杂认证向量的情况下实现远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Introduces path traversal risks in the .NET framework, potentially allowing local privilege escalation or unauthorized file system access in hosted applications.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Introduces path traversal risks in the .NET framework, potentially allowing local privilege escalation or unauthorized file system access in hosted applications.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 在 .NET framework 中引入路径遍历风险，可能导致托管应用程序发生本地提权或未授权的文件系统访问。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap overflow in WDAC OLE DB provider allows remote code execution. This vulnerability targets database connectivity layers, threatening data integrity and enabling unauthorized system control.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap overflow in WDAC OLE DB provider allows remote code execution. This vulnerability targets database connectivity layers, threatening data integrity and enabling unauthorized system control.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: WDAC OLE DB provider 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞针对数据库连接层，威胁数据完整性并允许未授权的系统控制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables remote code execution. Insecure deserialization remains a top-tier threat for database engines, allowing direct server compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables remote code execution. Insecure deserialization remains a top-tier threat for database engines, allowing direct server compromise.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可触发远程代码执行。不安全的反序列化仍是数据库引擎的首要威胁，可直接导致服务器沦陷。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper encoding in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation. Flaws in AD CS middleware can undermine PKI trust models and enable unauthorized certificate issuance.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper encoding in Active Directory Certificate Services allows privilege escalation. Flaws in AD CS middleware can undermine PKI trust models and enable unauthorized certificate issuance.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 中的编码不当漏洞可导致权限提升。AD CS 中间件的缺陷会破坏 PKI 信任模型并允许未授权签发证书。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 9.8 heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, representing a critical threat to database integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap overflow in SQL Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, representing a critical threat to database integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的堆溢出漏洞，可导致未授权远程代码执行，对数据库完整性构成严重威胁。

Databases & Middleware.reason: CVSS 8.8 SQL injection flaw in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation, exploiting common query handling weaknesses.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 SQL injection flaw in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation, exploiting common query handling weaknesses.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的 SQL 注入漏洞，可利用常见的查询处理缺陷实现基于网络的提权。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unauthenticated heap overflow in Microsoft SQL Server over network enables direct code execution on database instances.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unauthenticated heap overflow in Microsoft SQL Server over network enables direct code execution on database instances.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中存在可通过网络触发的未授权堆溢出漏洞，可直接在数据库实例上执行代码。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate database operations remotely.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate database operations remotely.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者提权并远程操纵数据库操作。

Databases & Middleware.reason: LDAP race condition in Red Hat 389-ds-base causes improper thread handling, potentially destabilizing directory services and authentication flows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: LDAP race condition in Red Hat 389-ds-base causes improper thread handling, potentially destabilizing directory services and authentication flows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Red Hat 389-ds-base 中的 LDAP 竞态条件会导致线程处理不当，可能破坏目录服务稳定性及身份验证流程。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Out-of-bounds write during IVFFlat index building in pgvector can be leveraged to achieve arbitrary code execution within PostgreSQL environments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write during IVFFlat index building in pgvector can be leveraged to achieve arbitrary code execution within PostgreSQL environments.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: pgvector 在构建 IVFFlat 索引时存在越界写入漏洞，可被利用在 PostgreSQL 环境中实现任意代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper TLS certificate validation in the HashiCorp Vault KMS integration risks exposure of sensitive message queue data and secrets.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper TLS certificate validation in the HashiCorp Vault KMS integration risks exposure of sensitive message queue data and secrets.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: HashiCorp Vault KMS 集成中 TLS 证书验证不当，可能导致敏感消息队列数据和密钥泄露。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Unenforced property name length limits in the CBOR parser may lead to resource exhaustion or unexpected parsing behavior in binary data streams.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Unenforced property name length limits in the CBOR parser may lead to resource exhaustion or unexpected parsing behavior in binary data streams.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: CBOR 解析器未强制执行属性名称长度限制，可能导致二进制数据流出现资源耗尽或意外解析行为。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Allows unauthenticated SPARQL injection in research data queries, exposing sensitive academic datasets to unauthorized enumeration despite being read-only.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated SPARQL injection in research data queries, exposing sensitive academic datasets to unauthorized enumeration despite being read-only.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许在未授权的情况下对研究数据查询进行 SPARQL 注入，尽管接口为只读，仍会将敏感学术数据集暴露给未授权枚举。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Accepts unlimited WebSocket payload sizes without buffering limits, enabling unauthenticated attackers to cause severe denial-of-service by exhausting server memory.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Accepts unlimited WebSocket payload sizes without buffering limits, enabling unauthenticated attackers to cause severe denial-of-service by exhausting server memory.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 接受无限制的 WebSocket 负载大小且无缓冲限制，使未认证攻击者可通过耗尽服务器内存引发严重的拒绝服务攻击。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Leaks anonymous user tokens even when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing internal package repositories and build artifacts to unauthorized users.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Leaks anonymous user tokens even when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing internal package repositories and build artifacts to unauthorized users.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 即使已禁用匿名访问，仍会泄露匿名用户令牌，可能导致内部软件包仓库和构建产物暴露给未授权用户。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Improper handling of SPF macros in the DMARC processor causes authentication failures, allowing attackers to bypass email security policies and successfully conduct domain spoofing or phishing campaigns.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Improper handling of SPF macros in the DMARC processor causes authentication failures, allowing attackers to bypass email security policies and successfully conduct domain spoofing or phishing campaigns.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: DMARC 处理器对 SPF 宏的处理不当会导致身份验证失败，使攻击者能够绕过电子邮件安全策略，成功实施域名伪造或钓鱼活动。

Databases & Middleware.reason: n8n Oracle Database node SQL injection in table/schema fields allows unauthorized DDL/DML execution, threatening database integrity in automation workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: n8n Oracle Database node SQL injection in table/schema fields allows unauthorized DDL/DML execution, threatening database integrity in automation workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: n8n 的 Oracle Database 节点在表/模式字段中存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致未授权的 DDL/DML 执行，威胁自动化工作流中的数据库完整性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Apache Camel Quarkus XXE vulnerability in XSLT extension permits reading local files or performing SSRF when transforming externally supplied XML documents.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Apache Camel Quarkus XXE vulnerability in XSLT extension permits reading local files or performing SSRF when transforming externally supplied XML documents.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Apache Camel Quarkus 的 XSLT 扩展中存在 XXE 漏洞，在转换外部提供的 XML 文档时允许读取本地文件或发起 SSRF 攻击。

Databases & Middleware.reason: libgit2 shell command injection via SSH backend executes arbitrary OS commands by exploiting unescaped repository paths during standard git operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: libgit2 shell command injection via SSH backend executes arbitrary OS commands by exploiting unescaped repository paths during standard git operations.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: libgit2通过SSH后端的Shell命令注入漏洞，在标准Git操作期间利用未转义的仓库路径执行任意操作系统命令。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Authentication bypass and SQL injection during ground-station setup allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL, plant admin users, and forge session tokens.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Authentication bypass and SQL injection during ground-station setup allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL, plant admin users, and forge session tokens.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: 地面站配置过程中的身份验证绕过与SQL注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者执行任意SQL语句、植入管理员账户并伪造会话令牌。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Filter injection in n8n's Supabase node fails to escape field values, enabling attackers to read, update, or delete all rows in connected database tables.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Filter injection in n8n's Supabase node fails to escape field values, enabling attackers to read, update, or delete all rows in connected database tables.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: n8n的Supabase节点存在过滤器注入漏洞，未能正确转义字段值，导致攻击者可读取、更新或删除已连接数据库表中的所有数据行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: NoSQL injection in n8n's MongoDB Chat Memory node allows unauthenticated attackers to supply query operators in sessionId fields, accessing and manipulating chat history.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: NoSQL injection in n8n's MongoDB Chat Memory node allows unauthenticated attackers to supply query operators in sessionId fields, accessing and manipulating chat history.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: n8n的MongoDB聊天记忆节点存在NoSQL注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者在sessionId字段中传入查询运算符，从而访问和篡改聊天记录。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Credentials leak in n8n sends unencrypted passwords to unvalidated hosts, exposing sensitive account details and risking compromise across integrated database services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Credentials leak in n8n sends unencrypted passwords to unvalidated hosts, exposing sensitive account details and risking compromise across integrated database services.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: n8n存在凭证泄露漏洞，会将未加密的密码发送至未经验证的主机，暴露敏感账户信息并危及集成数据库服务的安全。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Path traversal in dbGate's file upload endpoint allows attackers to overwrite critical system files or inject malicious scripts into the database management interface.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Path traversal in dbGate's file upload endpoint allows attackers to overwrite critical system files or inject malicious scripts into the database management interface.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: dbGate的文件上传接口存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可借此覆盖关键系统文件或向数据库管理界面注入恶意脚本。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Stored SQL injection in Kiteworks reporting features allows authenticated administrators to exfiltrate sensitive data or disrupt service availability in database-backed workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Stored SQL injection in Kiteworks reporting features allows authenticated administrators to exfiltrate sensitive data or disrupt service availability in database-backed workflows.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Kiteworks的报表功能存在存储型SQL注入漏洞，已认证管理员可利用该漏洞窃取敏感数据或破坏基于数据库工作流的服务可用性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Missing URL filtering in the JWT validator allows server-side request forgery attacks against internal middleware services and backend databases.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Missing URL filtering in the JWT validator allows server-side request forgery attacks against internal middleware services and backend databases.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: JWT验证器缺少URL过滤机制，可导致针对内部中间件服务和后端数据库的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）攻击。

Other.reason: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Mooncake transfer engine allows arbitrary memory read/write over TCP. Poses severe risks to AI inference infrastructure and distributed training clusters.
Other.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Mooncake transfer engine allows arbitrary memory read/write over TCP. Poses severe risks to AI inference infrastructure and distributed training clusters.
Other.reason_zh: Mooncake传输引擎存在不受信任的指针解引用漏洞，可通过TCP实现任意内存读写，对AI推理基础设施和分布式训练集群构成严重风险。

Other.reason: Double free in libarchive's RAR5 reader triggers crashes or potential code execution during archive parsing. Impacts cross-platform file extraction utilities used across enterprise environments.
Other.reason_en: Double free in libarchive's RAR5 reader triggers crashes or potential code execution during archive parsing. Impacts cross-platform file extraction utilities used across enterprise environments.
Other.reason_zh: libarchive的RAR5解析器存在双重释放漏洞，在解析归档文件时可能引发崩溃或潜在代码执行，影响企业环境中广泛使用的跨平台文件解压工具。

Other.reason: Off-by-one error in GLib's key file parser causes out-of-bounds access or denial of service. Affects foundational Linux/GNOME desktop libraries and system services.
Other.reason_en: Off-by-one error in GLib's key file parser causes out-of-bounds access or denial of service. Affects foundational Linux/GNOME desktop libraries and system services.
Other.reason_zh: GLib的键值文件解析器存在差一错误，会导致越界访问或拒绝服务，影响Linux/GNOME桌面基础库及系统服务。

Other.reason: Missing memory release in Active Directory Domain Services causes denial of service. While not immediately exploitable for code execution, resource exhaustion can disrupt authentication and directory services at scale.
Other.reason_en: Missing memory release in Active Directory Domain Services causes denial of service. While not immediately exploitable for code execution, resource exhaustion can disrupt authentication and directory services at scale.
Other.reason_zh: Active Directory域服务存在内存释放缺失漏洞，会导致拒绝服务。尽管短期内难以直接用于代码执行，但资源耗尽仍可能在大规模环境下破坏身份验证与目录服务。

Other.reason: CVSS 8.8 untrusted pointer dereference in Hyper-V allows local code execution, posing significant risks to virtualized infrastructure.
Other.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 untrusted pointer dereference in Hyper-V allows local code execution, posing significant risks to virtualized infrastructure.
Other.reason_zh: Hyper-V中存在CVSS评分为8.8的不受信任指针解引用漏洞，可导致本地代码执行，对虚拟化基础设施构成重大风险。

Other.reason: CVSS 7.5 use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables network code execution, threatening core directory authentication systems.
Other.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services enables network code execution, threatening core directory authentication systems.
Other.reason_zh: Active Directory域服务中存在CVSS评分为7.5的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可触发网络代码执行，威胁核心目录认证系统。

Other.reason: Out-of-bounds read in Windows NTFS allows local privilege escalation, affecting core file system integrity and bypassing standard user-level security boundaries.
Other.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows NTFS allows local privilege escalation, affecting core file system integrity and bypassing standard user-level security boundaries.
Other.reason_zh: Windows NTFS存在越界读取漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，影响核心文件系统完整性并绕过标准用户级安全边界。

Other.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Raw Image Extension enables remote code execution, impacting systems that process untrusted image files across various applications.
Other.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Raw Image Extension enables remote code execution, impacting systems that process untrusted image files across various applications.
Other.reason_zh: Windows原始图像扩展存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，影响各类应用中处理不受信任图像文件的系统。

Other.reason: Memory exhaustion vulnerability in Mooncake transfer engine allows unbounded process growth via repeated handshake RPC frames, impacting AI infrastructure stability.
Other.reason_en: Memory exhaustion vulnerability in Mooncake transfer engine allows unbounded process growth via repeated handshake RPC frames, impacting AI infrastructure stability.
Other.reason_zh: Mooncake传输引擎存在内存耗尽漏洞，攻击者可通过重复发送握手RPC帧导致进程无限制增长，影响AI基础设施的稳定性。

Other.reason: Unauthenticated RCE in Eclipse Equinox OSGi console permits attackers to execute arbitrary commands via exposed telnet connections.
Other.reason_en: Unauthenticated RCE in Eclipse Equinox OSGi console permits attackers to execute arbitrary commands via exposed telnet connections.
Other.reason_zh: Eclipse Equinox OSGi控制台存在未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，攻击者可通过暴露的Telnet连接执行任意命令。

Other.reason: Uncontrolled recursion in Amazon Ion Python reader triggers denial of service when processing deeply nested crafted values.
Other.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Amazon Ion Python reader triggers denial of service when processing deeply nested crafted values.
Other.reason_zh: Amazon Ion Python解析器存在不受控制的递归漏洞，在处理深度嵌套的构造值时会触发拒绝服务。

Other.reason: Path traversal in the tsk_recover utility allows attackers to write recovered files to arbitrary locations outside the intended target directory.
Other.reason_en: Path traversal in the tsk_recover utility allows attackers to write recovered files to arbitrary locations outside the intended target directory.
Other.reason_zh: tsk_recover工具存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞将恢复的文件写入预期目标目录之外的任意位置。

Other.reason: Argument injection in Git MCP server tools lacks dash validation, enabling attackers to write files outside repository boundaries.
Other.reason_en: Argument injection in Git MCP server tools lacks dash validation, enabling attackers to write files outside repository boundaries.
Other.reason_zh: Git MCP服务器工具存在参数注入漏洞，因缺乏对连字符的验证，攻击者可借此在仓库边界外写入文件。

Other.reason: Crafted PDFs with numerous embedded attachments cause repeated dictionary reparsing, leading to significant CPU exhaustion and denial of service.
Other.reason_en: Crafted PDFs with numerous embedded attachments cause repeated dictionary reparsing, leading to significant CPU exhaustion and denial of service.
Other.reason_zh: 包含大量嵌入附件的构造PDF文件会导致字典被反复重新解析，引发严重的CPU耗尽和拒绝服务。

Other.reason: Sandbox escape vulnerability in vm2 allows malicious code to break out of isolated execution environments, potentially compromising the host Node.js application.
Other.reason_en: Sandbox escape vulnerability in vm2 allows malicious code to break out of isolated execution environments, potentially compromising the host Node.js application.
Other.reason_zh: vm2存在沙箱逃逸漏洞，恶意代码可突破隔离执行环境，进而可能危害宿主机Node.js应用。

Other.reason: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in Fortra BoKS registration daemon enables immediate remote code execution, completely compromising privileged access management infrastructure.
Other.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in Fortra BoKS registration daemon enables immediate remote code execution, completely compromising privileged access management infrastructure.
Other.reason_zh: Fortra BoKS注册守护进程存在远程栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致即时远程代码执行，完全破坏特权访问管理基础设施。

Other.reason: HOTP verification flaw allows token replay and counter rewinding, bypassing two-factor authentication and compromising threat intelligence platform access.
Other.reason_en: HOTP verification flaw allows token replay and counter rewinding, bypassing two-factor authentication and compromising threat intelligence platform access.
Other.reason_zh: HOTP验证缺陷允许令牌重放和计数器回退，可绕过双因素认证并危及威胁情报平台的访问安全。

Other.reason: Cryptographic decryption failures incorrectly fall back to unauthenticated AES-CTR mode, permitting undetected ciphertext bit-flipping attacks and completely bypassing integrity verification mechanisms.
Other.reason_en: Cryptographic decryption failures incorrectly fall back to unauthenticated AES-CTR mode, permitting undetected ciphertext bit-flipping attacks and completely bypassing integrity verification mechanisms.
Other.reason_zh: 加密解密失败时错误降级至未认证的AES-CTR模式，允许未被检测到的密文比特翻转攻击，完全绕过完整性验证机制。

Other.reason: Token Optimizer MCP OS command injection via smart_user tool compromises AI coding agents and their shared knowledge graphs across CLI clients.
Other.reason_en: Token Optimizer MCP OS command injection via smart_user tool compromises AI coding agents and their shared knowledge graphs across CLI clients.
Other.reason_zh: 通过smart_user工具的Token Optimizer MCP存在OS命令注入漏洞，会危及AI编程代理及其在CLI客户端间的共享知识图谱。

Other.reason: OpenSave manifest handler fails to validate save paths, allowing cross-directory file read/write operations that can overwrite system configurations.
Other.reason_en: OpenSave manifest handler fails to validate save paths, allowing cross-directory file read/write operations that can overwrite system configurations.
Other.reason_zh: OpenSave清单处理器未能验证保存路径，允许跨目录文件读写操作，可能导致系统配置被覆盖。

Other.reason: Expat quadratic algorithmic complexity in attribute processing triggers severe denial of service when parsing documents with numerous non-normalized attributes.
Other.reason_en: Expat quadratic algorithmic complexity in attribute processing triggers severe denial of service when parsing documents with numerous non-normalized attributes.
Other.reason_zh: Expat在处理属性时存在二次算法复杂度问题，解析包含大量未归一化属性的文档时会触发严重的拒绝服务。

Other.reason: Predictable pseudo-random password generation in Fortra BoKS compromises Active Directory service accounts, enabling unauthorized access and lateral movement in enterprise environments.
Other.reason_en: Predictable pseudo-random password generation in Fortra BoKS compromises Active Directory service accounts, enabling unauthorized access and lateral movement in enterprise environments.
Other.reason_zh: Fortra BoKS的可预测伪随机密码生成机制会危及Active Directory服务账户，使攻击者能够在企业环境中实现未授权访问和横向移动。

Other.reason: Heap buffer overflow in zlib after failed write operations can corrupt memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in applications relying on compressed data streams.
Other.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in zlib after failed write operations can corrupt memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in applications relying on compressed data streams.
Other.reason_zh: zlib在写入操作失败后发生堆缓冲区溢出，可能导致内存损坏，进而使依赖压缩数据流的应用程序面临任意代码执行风险。

Other.reason: Improper validation of unsafe equivalence in OpenDMARC policy handling could lead to misconfiguration or bypass of email authentication policies in middleware deployments.
Other.reason_en: Improper validation of unsafe equivalence in OpenDMARC policy handling could lead to misconfiguration or bypass of email authentication policies in middleware deployments.
Other.reason_zh: OpenDMARC在处理策略时对不安全等价性的验证不当，可能导致中间件部署中的邮件认证策略配置错误或遭绕过。

Other.reason: Encoding error in OpenDMARC's internationalized domain name handler may cause parsing failures or bypasses in email authentication workflows.
Other.reason_en: Encoding error in OpenDMARC's internationalized domain name handler may cause parsing failures or bypasses in email authentication workflows.
Other.reason_zh: OpenDMARC的国际化域名处理程序存在编码错误，可能导致邮件认证工作流中出现解析失败或安全绕过。

Other.reason: Bypassed ring buffer guard in the AV1 encoder causes heap buffer overflows, impacting media processing pipelines and desktop multimedia applications.
Other.reason_en: Bypassed ring buffer guard in the AV1 encoder causes heap buffer overflows, impacting media processing pipelines and desktop multimedia applications.
Other.reason_zh: AV1编码器中环形缓冲区守卫被绕过会导致堆缓冲区溢出，影响媒体处理流水线及桌面多媒体应用。

summary: Today's threat landscape is characterized by pervasive remote code execution and memory corruption vulnerabilities affecting desktop operating systems, web platforms, and network infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems bearing the brunt through critical flaws in Windows kernel components, Azure cloud services, and Exchange servers. High-severity risks also permeate industrial control and IoT environments via unauthenticated command injection and hardcoded credentials, while new attack vectors emerge targeting AI inference frameworks and developer toolchains through sandbox escapes and path traversals. Organizations face compounded exposure from these widespread exploitation opportunities that compromise authentication integrity, data confidentiality, and system stability across enterprise and edge deployments.
summary_en: Today's threat landscape is characterized by pervasive remote code execution and memory corruption vulnerabilities affecting desktop operating systems, web platforms, and network infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems bearing the brunt through critical flaws in Windows kernel components, Azure cloud services, and Exchange servers. High-severity risks also permeate industrial control and IoT environments via unauthenticated command injection and hardcoded credentials, while new attack vectors emerge targeting AI inference frameworks and developer toolchains through sandbox escapes and path traversals. Organizations face compounded exposure from these widespread exploitation opportunities that compromise authentication integrity, data confidentiality, and system stability across enterprise and edge deployments.
summary_zh: 当前威胁态势以广泛存在的远程代码执行与内存损坏漏洞为特征，波及桌面操作系统、Web平台及网络基础设施，其中微软生态系统首当其冲，Windows内核组件、Azure云服务及Exchange服务器均存在关键缺陷。高危风险亦通过未认证命令注入与硬编码凭据渗透至工业控制与物联网环境，同时新型攻击向量正借助沙箱逃逸和路径遍历针对AI推理框架及开发者工具链涌现。面对这些广泛的漏洞利用机会，组织在企业级与边缘部署中面临的身份验证完整性、数据机密性及系统稳定性受损风险进一步叠加。
